name: Suburbia (Collector's Edition)

categories.label: Population on the board at end
categories.hint: Population track after your last turn (before goals and money; red lines are ignored in final scoring).

categories.label: Public goal Population bonuses won
categories.labelVi: Thưởng dân số mục tiêu công khai
categories.hint: Add the printed Population bonus of each public goal you alone achieved (ties: nobody scores it).

categories.label: Private goal Population bonus
categories.labelVi: Thưởng dân số mục tiêu bí mật
categories.hint: Printed Population bonus on your private goal tile if you alone achieved it (ties on that goal: none).

categories.label: Money converted to Population
categories.labelVi: Tiền quy đổi thành dân số
categories.hint: Enter your money after goals are decided: 1 Population per full $5.

tiebreakers.description: Tie: highest Reputation, then highest Income, then most remaining money (excluding the money converted to Population).
Still tied: tied players play again.

notes: family: end-game-categories (Population track + goals + money). Goal Population values are printed on each goal tile and vary, so they are scorer inputs; goals must be resolved before converting money (Billionaire / Spendthrift goals use money held before conversion). Solo ladder (Lone Architect, Dale the Bot) and Suburbia expansion tiles not modelled. Verified in the Suburbia 2nd Edition / Collector's Edition rules reference (Bezier Games, v2.3.1), which is image-only; page 5 read visually.
